youtube_description:
By default, you can only connect a Macbook Air to 1 External Display/Monitor. However, there is a workaround! Buy yourself the following adapter:

(BUY ONE OF THESE ADAPTERS FOR YOUR MONITOR):

STEP 1: BUY ONE OF THESE ADAPTERS, DEPENDING ON WHAT MONITOR CABLE YOU WANT TO CONNECT:
Startech HDMI Adapter: https://geni.us/LsLyPY or https://geni.us/YEZhwr
Startech DisplayPort Adapter: https://geni.us/egjg
Startech USB 3.0 DisplayPort Adapter: https://www.startech.com/AV/display-and-video-adapters/USB-Video-Adapters/USB-3-to-Displayport-Video-Card-Multi-Monitor-Adapter-2560x1600~USB32DPPRO

STEP 2: CONNECT A CORRESPONDING CABLE TO THE ADAPTER: 

For the DisplayPort Version Adapter: 
DVI to DisplayPort: https://geni.us/Zcog or HDMI to DisplayPort: https://geni.us/GO5jE

For the HDMI Version Adapter: Any HDMI to HDMI Cable Will do.

STEP 3: DOWNLOAD THE DISPLAY LINK MAC SOFTWARE:

Download here: https://www.synaptics.com/products/displaylink-graphics/downloads/macos

You may also need a DisplayPort to DVI Monitor Cable to connect it to your external monitor, depending on the display you have.

If you have any questions on this, do not hesitate to ask in the comments below!
